items.docs:
Obtain JWT access and refresh tokens.

Accepts either username or email with password for authentication.
Compatible with Django REST Framework SimpleJWT token endpoint.
Supports both application/json and application/x-www-form-urlencoded.

Args:
    request: The incoming HTTP request.

Returns:
    TokenResponse with access and refresh JWT tokens.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 401 if credentials are invalid.

Refresh an access token using a refresh token.

Accepts {"refresh": "<token>"} in the request body, matching Django SimpleJWT.

Args:
    body: Request body containing the refresh token.

Returns:
    TokenResponse with new access and refresh tokens.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 401 if refresh token is invalid.

Verify a JWT token is valid and not expired.

Mirrors Django SimpleJWT TokenVerifyView. Returns {} on success.

Args:
    body: Request body containing the token to verify.

Returns:
    Empty dict on success.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 401 if token is invalid or expired.

Authenticate user with username/password and return access token.

This endpoint is provided for UI login compatibility with Django.
It returns an access token with a custom lifetime based on the `days` parameter.

Args:
    request: Token request containing username/email and password.
    days: Token lifetime in days (default 1, max 30).

Returns:
    UsernamePasswordLoginResponse with access token and lifetime string.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 400 if credentials are invalid.

info.name: Exchange an external token for a PAPI JWT

items.docs:
Exchange an Auth0 access token for a PAPI JWT.

This endpoint implements a simplified RFC 8693 token exchange. It
validates the Auth0 token against Auth0's /userinfo endpoint, looks up
the corresponding PAPI user by email, and issues a PAPI JWT.

Intended for use by the MCP server after completing an OAuth 2.1 flow
with Auth0 — the MCP server receives an Auth0 access token from the
interactive login and exchanges it here for a PAPI JWT that can be
used for API calls.
